message.content:
Checking the infobox of the Moon Wikipedia page to see if minimum perigee is listed explicitly in the infobox or in text.
```python
cmd = '''python -c "
import urllib.request
import json

url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=parse&page=Moon&prop=wikitext&format=json'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
res = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
data = json.loads(res.read().decode('utf-8'))
wt = data['parse']['wikitext']['*']

# Print infobox lines
in_infobox = False
for line in wt.splitlines():
    if '{{Infobox planet' in line or '{{Infobox body' in line or '{{Infobox' in line:
        in_infobox = True
    if in_infobox:
        print(line)
        if line.startswith('}}'):
            break
"'''
res_infobox = await run_command(cmd)
print(res_infobox)
```
